items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I wrote 'Perdido' and 'Jeffries' was next to me in the seat in the coach, and I started singing this thing to him and he started singing it, too, and I gave it to Duke.

ctx.x: You know, "Perdido" was written on the train, on a coach train. I wrote "Perdido" and "Jeffries" was next to me in the seat in the coach, and I started singing this thing to him and he started singing it, too, and I gave it to Duke.
